comparison.objective: Drive opposed tapered shims until a jamb is snug without bowing; candidate calibrates sensor mounts.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual wedge insertion and force-balanced snugging versus screwdriver access and pose retention during mount tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Opposed pair overlaps ≥70 mm, gap ≤0.05 mm, bow ≤0.4 mm, released 2 s; candidate uses sensing clearance and over-center criteria.
comparison.reason: Force-controlled wedging is materially different from two-endpoint sensor registration. Candidate’s fastening-force and post-tightening drift thresholds are unresolved.
